principles: DO NOT UPDATE-IN-PLACE any existing SKU or historical Tagada mapping
OLD SKU → DEPRECATE → NEW SKU → NEW GEN mapping → NEW Tagada mapping
GEN product/pairing IDs are external references — MBM SKU remains commerce identity
Never use Tagada priceId as a clinical identifier
Accessories excluded from GEN medication mapping

CURRENT.meaning: Live MBM sellable; GEN fields null/TBD
CURRENT.checkout: Unchanged Tagada path via existing kashu_sku_map + combo priceIds

NEW_READY.meaning: New MBM SKU + GEN pairing + costs complete; Tagada map for NEW SKU prepared; not yet storefront-primary

DUAL_MAPPED.meaning: New SKU live for new enrollments; old SKU deprecated for new sales; history intact
DUAL_MAPPED.checkout: Storefront sells NEW SKU only; old map may remain inactive for disputes

DEPRECATED.meaning: Old SKU not sellable; retained for historical orders

BLOCKED.checkout: Must not be purchasable — fail closed

markup_rules.note: Markups on total_cost (med+ship), not profit margins. Not applied automatically.

sku_creation_rules: New formulation = new SKU (never reuse retired SKU)
B6 → B12/glycine/other additive change = new SKU
Propose NEW SKUs only after GEN pairing confirms formulation delta
